revision.working_tree: uncommitted implementation over the recorded HEAD

bounds.weight_model: 128 B per page plus 256 B per node plus two bytes per character of display, target, provenance and state
bounds.ancestor_overflow: Reject the new page atomically and preserve the current view; do not evict its ancestors
bounds.eviction: Least recently visited eligible branch; prune unreachable descendants; reload on expansion or Load calls

measurement_method.comparison_order: five baseline pages, then five final implementation pages on the same local host
measurement_method.scope: actual CallTreePane mounted in isolation with synthetic page responses; excludes Rust service and Tauri WebKit
measurement_method.heap: Runtime.getHeapUsage.usedSize after forced HeapProfiler.collectGarbage; subtract mounted-page heap from post-browsing heap
measurement_method.timing: 100 expansion samples per page, each including two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; separate continuous frame interval samples
measurement_method.equivalence: Baseline component bytes match recorded HEAD. Final component and page-cache hashes match the tested working tree. The later test-fixture change does not affect these runtime files.
measurement_method.metadata_addition: The same diagnostic workload is used for both versions. Host, lockfile and helper-source fields were added to the reporter after the baseline; they run after measurement and do not change the workload.
measurement_method.baseline_host_identity_note: Same session, installed dependencies and host as final probe; baseline reporter did not yet emit host fields

after.scope: synthetic frontend diagnostic; actual CallTreePane; no Rust service or device

comparison.conclusion: Lower retained page heap growth under this workload; frame interval p95 remains approximately unchanged. No claim of JavaScript execution speedup.

test_notes: New tests cover both count and string-weight bounds, LRU, protected ancestors, rejection atomicity, orphan cleanup, a retained 5,000-node path, reload, pagination, pending request coalescing, stale responses and retries.

An initial full run exceeded the existing App test 5-second deadline during concurrent work. The new eviction regression was reduced from 83 small branches to six long-display branches that cross the weight bound; the final normal suite passes without changing test timeouts.
ESLint briefly raced with Playwright replacing test-results during parallel execution. Final lint, build and production E2E ran sequentially and passed.

browser.method: Actual Chromium UI and Rust production service behind the existing authenticated E2E loopback transport; no response mocks or product-code changes.

limitations: The four source reports are retained Xiaomi captures from earlier on 2026-10-19. No new Android capture or device performance benchmark was run.
All four real trees have fewer than 100 roots in their initial page; root Previous/Next window coverage is from component regression tests.
The browser diagnostic measures the whole page after GC, including React overhead. Cache weight is a bounded accounting measure, not an actual browser heap ceiling.
A 5,000-node path is retained by the model regression. Paths whose ancestor pages alone exceed the budget reject further pages explicitly.
No new fixed-host scale gate, rich service performance run, Tauri WebKit measurement, CPU profile, high-zoom layout or complete keyboard accessibility acceptance was performed.
